description: This Java source file defines an abstract utility class GrepHelper with two concrete inner classes for different platform-specific grep command implementations. It provides methods to construct grep commands with customizable options and handles platform differences.

classes.name: GrepHelper
classes.description: An abstract helper class for constructing grep command-line invocations with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: GrepHelper.PcreGrepHelper
classes.description: Handles creating grep commands using 'pcre2grep' with PCRE-specific patterns.

classes.name: GrepHelper.BsdGrepHelper
classes.description: Handles creating grep commands using 'egrep' with BSD-style regex patterns.

methods.name: GrepHelper.getHelper
methods.description: Factory method to return the appropriate GrepHelper instance based on platform version.

methods.name: GrepHelper.getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the grep command used.

methods.name: GrepHelper.getMetaCharacters
methods.description: Returns an array of meta characters or patterns supported.

methods.name: GrepHelper.buildCommand
methods.description: Builds a grep command string with specified pattern and options.
